headline: Central Asian States Seek Developer for Regional Spot Electricity Market
summary: Kazakhstan state grid operator KEGOC announced a World Bank-backed tender to select a firm for a 24-month project to establish a regional spot electricity market across four Central Asian nations.
why: KEGOC manages Kazakhstan's national power grid, serving as a key transmission hub for Central Asian energy trade.

impacts.name: Central Asia Utilities
impacts.why: Establishing a centralized spot market standardizes power trading across Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, and Tajikistan.
